verdict.rationale: Jitsu documents a public Management HTTP API with a "full OpenAPI 3.0 reference at docs.jitsu.com/api" covering workspaces, destinations, connections, syncs and functions. Nothing in the evidence says this reference is interactive or offers runnable examples (e.g., try-it-out consoles). The probe's 404s on guessed spec-file paths do not contradict the documented reference location, so this is not a dispute. Missing for 10: evidence the reference is interactive, runnable/try-it examples, a publicly fetchable OpenAPI spec file, and independent hands-on corroboration.
